import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial, PlaneGeometry, Mesh, DoubleSide, Color } from 'three/webgpu';
import { vec4, uv, mix, smoothstep } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { THREE } = ctx;
  const group = new THREE.Group();

  const activeTimelines = [];
  const geometriesToDispose = [];
  const materialsToDispose = [];
  const texturesToDispose = [];

  // STAGE BACKGROUND & GRADIENT SURFACE
  const geom = new PlaneGeometry(4.2, 2.6);
  geometriesToDispose.push(geom);

  const mat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    side: DoubleSide,
    transparent: true
  });
  materialsToDispose.push(mat);

  const inkColor = new Color('#16161d');
  const surfaceColor = new Color('#0b0b10');
  const accentColor = new Color('#ff2a38');

  // Custom TSL Shader constructing the structured background
  mat.colorNode = (() => {
    const coords = uv();
    
    // Smooth diagonal sweep for surface/ink transition
    const diag = coords.x.add(coords.y).mul(0.5);
    const bg = mix(
      vec4(surfaceColor.r, surfaceColor.g, surfaceColor.b, 1.0),
      vec4(inkColor.r, inkColor.g, inkColor.b, 1.0),
      diag
    );

    // Precise accent signal line at the top edge of the card boundary
    const lineMask = smoothstep(0.97, 0.98, coords.y).mul(smoothstep(0.0, 0.2, coords.x));
    const finalColor = mix(
      bg,
      vec4(accentColor.r, accentColor.g, accentColor.b, 1.0),
      lineMask.mul(0.85)
    );

    return finalColor;
  })();

  const basePlane = new Mesh(geom, mat);
  group.add(basePlane);

  // HERO IMAGE (Collection Card 2 - orb-decor)
  if (config.imageUrl) {
    const imgGeom = new PlaneGeometry(3.6, 2.2);
    geometriesToDispose.push(imgGeom);

    const imgMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
      transparent: true,
      side: DoubleSide,
      opacity: 0.0
    });
    materialsToDispose.push(imgMat);

    const imgMesh = new Mesh(imgGeom, imgMat);
    imgMesh.position.set(0, 0, 0.02); // Slightly front to prevent Z-fight
    group.add(imgMesh);

    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl).then((tex) => {
      texturesToDispose.push(tex);
      imgMat.colorNode = vec4(tex.uv(uv()).rgb, 1.0);
      imgMat.needsUpdate = true;
      
      const tl = gsap.to(imgMat, {
        opacity: 1,
        duration: 0.8,
        ease: 'power3.out'
      });
      activeTimelines.push(tl);
    });
  }

  // Explicit positioning corresponding to template design
  group.position.set(0, -0.3, 0);

  // Mandatory userData cleanup integration
  group.userData.cleanup = function() {
    activeTimelines.forEach((tl) => tl.kill());
    geometriesToDispose.forEach((g) => g.dispose());
    materialsToDispose.forEach((m) => m.dispose());
    texturesToDispose.forEach((t) => t.dispose());
  };

  return group;
}
